title: Placing the Travel Fee in a Fine Arts Payment Plan by Days to the Next Performance Trip — Student Activities, Athletics and Trip Fees
content:
**Travel fee in the installment plan.** For a Fine Arts Performing Ensemble participation for the 2026-27 school year whose registration date is after 2026-08-03, the travel fee of **Student Activities, Athletics and Trip Fees** is placed by the calendar days from the first installment to the first of the ensemble's trips on or after it, the trips being on 2026-10-24, 2026-12-12, 2027-02-26 and 2027-04-30 for band and orchestra and on 2026-11-06, 2027-01-29, 2027-03-26 and 2027-05-07 otherwise:

1. with no more than 30 days, the whole travel fee net is due up front, and the travel fee does not stay in the plan total;
2. with more than 30 but no more than 60 days, the first installment carries the travel fee net divided by the monthly due dates from the first installment up to that trip, rounded down to the cent, the rest falling due on the later pre-trip due dates; the travel fee does not stay in the plan total;
3. otherwise, or when no trip falls on or after the first installment, the travel fee net stays in the plan total.

The monthly due dates up to the trip are the first installment's date and the same day of each following month, through the trip date.

## Input, judgement, placement (hypothetical dates and a hypothetical travel fee net of 101.15)

| First installment | Ensemble | Next trip, days away | Placement | Carried in the first installment |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 2026-11-15 | band | 2026-12-12, 27 days | whole net up front | 101.15 |
| 2026-11-02 | band | 2026-12-12, 40 days | 2 due dates (11-02, 12-02) | 101.15 divided by 2, 50.575, rounded down: 50.57 |
| 2026-11-07 | choir | 2027-01-29, 83 days | stays in the plan total | nothing up front |
